poll.source_locator: Embedded WICK_PACKET_DATA, Q9 'Governor ballot' ('If the November 2026 election for governor of Wisconsin were held today, for whom would you vote?'): David Crowley, the Democrat 47.71; Tom Tiffany, the Republican 44.63; Undecided / Not sure 7.66
poll.notes: n is the published weighted total (1,213); unweighted n not disclosed. MoE +/-3.0. League of American Workers is a conservative advocacy group founded by Steve Cortes (Wikipedia efn); same sponsor as the TIPP Aug WI poll. No release date on the page; Wikipedia access-date 2026-10-28. Wikipedia rounds 48-45-8.
